questions.question: Describe an electrical design project at Donan Solutions where you developed specifications, calculations, and a construction or production package. What was your specific technical contribution?

This role involves digital circuit design around microprocessors. What exposure have you had through your Electrical and Computer Engineering education or work to microcontrollers, digital logic, or embedded systems?
What programming have you done in C, C++, or other languages, and can you walk us through a technically challenging program you created or modified?

The position requires schematic capture and PCB layout coordination. What CAD tools have you used, and what types of electrical drawings, schematics, or layouts have you produced in AutoCAD or other tools?
Describe how you review an engineering design package against customer requirements, applicable codes, and manufacturing or installation constraints.
Give an example of a project where you had to resolve a technical issue involving several engineering disciplines, contractors, or customers. How did you drive the resolution?
How have you performed electrical calculations to establish equipment ratings, installation requirements, or manufacturing specifications? Please provide a concrete example.
This role supports products moving into production. What documentation have you prepared to help manufacturing, installation, or field teams build and support an electrical design correctly?
What experience do you have using test or diagnostic equipment to troubleshoot electrical or technical systems, and how did you document and validate the resolution?
This position is onsite five days per week in Parsippany, New Jersey. Are you able to meet that onsite requirement?
